title: Partholan, the first colonist of Ireland
summary: Partholan, the first colonist of Ireland
description: Record first created by the Generations curriculum import (Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024)). CFAH dates it as well (added by the CFAH pass); the sort follows the four-tier rule.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 2035 BC (AP-103, OSF preprint CFAH-18). Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-10-18): was provisional (Generations) 2036 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-18: The Ancient Chronology of Ireland," OSF preprint v1.4 (17 Aug 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/28P43, file cfah-18_v1.4.pdf, p. 8 ("Anchor Point #103, Partholón’s Discovery of Ireland in 2035 BC")
Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024), ch. 6 "The Dispersion and the Descent into Darkness", PDF p. 131 (printed p. 117)
chronologies.note: First year of Semiramis; first permanent settlement 2024 BC (same page). p. 158 prints "by 2035 BC".
